headword: ゆうちょ{銀行|ぎんこう}

definitions.explanation: A nationwide bank operated by the Japan Post group. Its branches share counters with post offices, and its ATMs are found throughout Japan, making it one of the most widely accessible financial institutions in the country.

examples.japanese: ゆうちょ{銀行|ぎんこう}に{口座|こうざ}を{開|ひら}いた。
examples.english: I opened an account at Japan Post Bank.

examples.japanese: {近|ちか}くの{郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}でゆうちょ{銀行|ぎんこう}のATMが{使|つか}える。
examples.english: You can use Japan Post Bank ATMs at the nearby post office.

examples.japanese: {家賃|やちん}はゆうちょ{銀行|ぎんこう}の{口座|こうざ}から{自動的|じどうてき}に{引|ひ}き{落|お}とされる。
examples.english: The rent is automatically debited from my Japan Post Bank account.

notes:
Spun off from the postal savings system in 2007 when Japan Post was privatized. The {郵便貯金|ゆうびんちょきん} (postal savings) it replaced is still a familiar term among older speakers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ゆうちょ{銀行|ぎんこう}の{口座|こうざ}: Japan Post Bank account
- ゆうちょATM: Japan Post Bank ATM
- ゆうちょ{銀行|ぎんこう}に{振|ふ}り{込|こ}む: to transfer to a Japan Post Bank account

USAGE:
Widely used because every post office across the country also functions as a branch counter. The {記号|きごう}-{番号|ばんごう} (5-digit symbol + 8-digit number) format of its accounts differs from ordinary bank account numbers and sometimes needs to be converted for transfers from other banks.
